nodes.label: Design system thumbnail page
nodes.rationale: A 1280x854 RTL identity card for the design system itself: the wordmark centred on brand-primary with a three-band accent strip, sized to be captured as the gallery thumbnail.

nodes.label: Stacked SAG Lab wordmark
nodes.rationale: Two Arabic words stacked at 250px with tightened line-height and negative letter-spacing so the mark reads as one block at any size.

nodes.label: Three-band brand accent strip
nodes.rationale: A fixed 320px column of teal, sky and deep navy - the palette shown as swatches next to the mark so the thumbnail carries the system's colours, not just its name.
